prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in green stepped rice terraces with a stone path, a waist-high stone wall and a standard-height farm hut door at her side, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Latina woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm golden-bronze skin, a sharp black winged liner, warm terracotta eyeshadow, heavy lashes, strong sculpted contour, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep berry lip, a fiery, passionate expression, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in a high top-knot bun, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long bronze chain ending in one large faceted sapphire drop, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (an iron chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a gold pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked platinum hair ornaments. Extremely long round nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide; a mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body, the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it; below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves; her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust; the bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Yoruba adire eleko pattern (a deep indigo ground with bold cream resist-painted geometric motifs), wide cream bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense geometric bird motifs filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme hot-pink ankle-strap stilettos with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Hawaiian man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful idol face with a small V-line jaw, bright expressive eyes and a straight nose, clean-shaven, graphic electric-blue eyeliner extended into bold wings, smooth warm bronze skin, a cool composed look, deep jet-black with a glossy sheen hair styled in a natural afro in a full rounded silhouette, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large copper hoop carrying one heavy rough hammered matte metal weight on copper chain (a gold barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large rose-gold hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on rose-gold chains of different lengths (a silver cube-shaped block, an iron barrel-shaped weight, an iron ship's anchor, a silver teardrop-shaped sinker, a bronze small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered rose-gold rings. Extremely long stiletto nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Cubist-fragmented pattern (sharp angular asymmetric flat planes seen from several angles at once), wide silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense angular fragment planes filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
